        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");

          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);

        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {

          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {

        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
              var link = links[i];
              var target = link.getAttribute(\"hreflang\") || \"\";
              if (!target) continue;
              var rest = segments.slice(1).join(\"/\");
              var href = \"/\" + target + (rest ? \"/\" + rest : \"\") + window.location.search;
              link.setAttribute(\"href\", href);

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
              var link = links[i];
              var target = link.getAttribute(\"hreflang\") || \"\";
              if (!target) continue;
              var rest = segments.slice(1).join(\"/\");
              var href = \"/\" + target + (rest ? \"/\" + rest : \"\") + window.location.search;
              link.setAttribute(\"href\", href);
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

          enhanceContentHooks();

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function enhanceContentHooks() {
          var diagrams = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".mermaid, [data-mermaid]\"));
          var maths = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".math-inline, .math-display, [data-math]\"));
          if (diagrams.length > 0) {
            loadVendorScript(\"/assets/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js\")
              .then(function () {
                renderDiagrams(diagrams);
              })
              .catch(function (err) {

              });

              })
              .catch(function (err) {
                console.warn(\"[katex] Renderer unavailable:\", err);
              });
          }
        }

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();

            script.onerror = function () {

            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }

          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");

        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
              var link = links[i];
              var target = link.getAttribute(\"hreflang\") || \"\";
              if (!target) continue;
              var rest = segments.slice(1).join(\"/\");
              var href = \"/\" + target + (rest ? \"/\" + rest : \"\") + window.location.search;

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function enhanceContentHooks() {
          var diagrams = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".mermaid, [data-mermaid]\"));

        }

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");

            };

          });
        }

        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid

        function renderMath(nodes) {

          });

          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
              var link = links[i];
              var target = link.getAttribute(\"hreflang\") || \"\";
              if (!target) continue;
              var rest = segments.slice(1).join(\"/\");
              var href = \"/\" + target + (rest ? \"/\" + rest : \"\") + window.location.search;
              link.setAttribute(\"href\", href);
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (document.readyState === \"loading\") {
          document.addEventListener(\"DOMContentLoaded\", function () {
            preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs();
            enhanceContentHooks();
          });
        } else {
          preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs();
          enhanceContentHooks();
        }····················
        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function enhanceContentHooks() {
          var diagrams = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".mermaid, [data-mermaid]\"));
          var maths = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".math-inline, .math-display, [data-math]\"));
          if (diagrams.length > 0) {

              })
              .catch(function (err) {
                console.warn(\"[katex] Renderer unavailable:\", err);
              });
          }
        }

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;

        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {

          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";

                });

        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);

            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {

              if (!target) continue;

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })

                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function enhanceContentHooks() {

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
              var link = links[i];
              var target = link.getAttribute(\"hreflang\") || \"\";
              if (!target) continue;
              var rest = segments.slice(1).join(\"/\");
              var href = \"/\" + target + (rest ? \"/\" + rest : \"\") + window.location.search;
              link.setAttribute(\"href\", href);
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

          enhanceContentHooks();

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function enhanceContentHooks() {
          var diagrams = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".mermaid, [data-mermaid]\"));
          var maths = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".math-inline, .math-display, [data-math]\"));
          if (diagrams.length > 0) {
            loadVendorScript(\"/assets/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js\")
              .then(function () {
                renderDiagrams(diagrams);

              });
          }
        }

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);

        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";

            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);

              window.mermaid

                });

              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;

            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });

              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function enhanceContentHooks() {

        }

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);

        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {

                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {

        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }

        function loadVendorScript(src) {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
              var link = links[i];
              var target = link.getAttribute(\"hreflang\") || \"\";
              if (!target) continue;
              var rest = segments.slice(1).join(\"/\");
              var href = \"/\" + target + (rest ? \"/\" + rest : \"\") + window.location.search;
              link.setAttribute(\"href\", href);
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (document.readyState === \"loading\") {
          document.addEventListener(\"DOMContentLoaded\", function () {
            preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs();
            enhanceContentHooks();
          });
        } else {
          preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs();
          enhanceContentHooks();
        }····················
        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function enhanceContentHooks() {
          var diagrams = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".mermaid, [data-mermaid]\"));
          var maths = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\".math-inline, .math-display, [data-math]\"));
          if (diagrams.length > 0) {
            loadVendorScript(\"/assets/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js\")
              .then(function () {
                renderDiagrams(diagrams);
              })
              .catch(function (err) {
                console.warn(\"[mermaid] Renderer unavailable:\", err);
              });
          }
          if (maths.length > 0) {
            ensureVendorStylesheet(\"/assets/vendor/katex/katex.min.css\");

              .then(function () {
                renderMath(maths);
              })
              .catch(function (err) {
                console.warn(\"[katex] Renderer unavailable:\", err);
              });
          }
        }

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");

          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);

        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";

            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);

          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;

              });

          });
        }

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {

        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {

          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {

        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();

            if (openDialog && !openDialog.hasAttribute(\"hidden\")) {
              openDialog.setAttribute(\"hidden\", \"\");
              if (lastSearchOpener && lastSearchOpener.focus) lastSearchOpener.focus();
              else {
                var fallback = searchOpener();
                if (fallback) fallback.focus();
              }
            }
            var nav = document.querySelector(\"#mobile-nav\");
            if (nav && !nav.hasAttribute(\"hidden\")) {
              nav.setAttribute(\"hidden\", \"\");
              var navOpener = document.querySelector(\"[data-nav-opener]\");
              if (navOpener) {
                navOpener.setAttribute(\"aria-expanded\", \"false\");
                navOpener.focus();
              }
            }
          }
        });
      })();
    </script>·

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;
          nodes.forEach(function (node) {
            var tex = node.getAttribute(\"data-tex\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!tex.trim()) return;
            try {
              window.katex.render(tex, node, {
                displayMode: node.classList.contains(\"math-display\"),
                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[katex] Failed to render math:\", err);
            }
          });
        }

        function loadVendorScript(src) {

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;

        function preserveLocaleSwitchHrefs() {
          try {
            var path = window.location.pathname || \"/\";
            var segments = path.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);
            var links = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-locale-switch]\");
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {

              var target = link.getAttribute(\"hreflang\") || \"\";
              if (!target) continue;
              var rest = segments.slice(1).join(\"/\");
              var href = \"/\" + target + (rest ? \"/\" + rest : \"\") + window.location.search;

        function loadVendorScript(src) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            if (document.querySelector('script[data-vendor-src=\"' + src + '\"]')) {
              resolve();
              return;
            }
            var script = document.createElement(\"script\");
            script.src = src;
            script.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-src\", src);
            script.onload = function () {
              resolve();
            };
            script.onerror = function () {
              reject(new Error(\"vendor script failed: \" + src));
            };
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          });
        }
        function ensureVendorStylesheet(href) {
          if (document.querySelector('link[data-vendor-href=\"' + href + '\"]')) return;
          var link = document.createElement(\"link\");
          link.rel = \"stylesheet\";
          link.href = href;
          link.setAttribute(\"data-vendor-href\", href);
          document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        function renderDiagrams(nodes) {
          if (!window.mermaid) return;
          try {
            window.mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"default\", securityLevel: \"loose\" });
          } catch (e) {}
          nodes.forEach(function (node, index) {
            var chart = node.getAttribute(\"data-chart\") || node.textContent || \"\";
            if (!chart.trim()) return;
            var id = \"mermaid-\" + index + \"-\" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
            try {
              window.mermaid
                .render(id, chart)
                .then(function (result) {
                  node.innerHTML = result.svg;
                })
                .catch(function (err) {
                  console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
                });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(\"[mermaid] Failed to render diagram:\", err);
            }
          });
        }
        function renderMath(nodes) {
          if (!window.katex) return;

            if (!tex.trim()) return;

                throwOnError: false,
              });
            } catch (err) {

            }
          });
        }
